warnings.headline: Flooding is expected: Keswick Campsite
warnings.description: Heavy rainfall overnight into this morning, Wednesday 28 October 2026, will cause the lake to rise. Further showers are expected today, Wednesday 28 October 2026. Lake levels are forecast to start falling from this evening. The flood warning is forecast to remain in force over the next few days. Locations most affected will be Keswick Campsite with flooding from the lake and the River Greta. We continue to closely monitor the situation . Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water. This message will be updated by 9:00AM on Thursday 29 October or as the situation changes.
